title: Hub description (hub.json at the root of a hub repository)

scope.description: What this hub lists, in a sentence or two.

intake.description: How projects apply, in plain words (e.g. a PR to the registry, or the Add project issue form).

registry.description: Directory of registry entries, e.g. registry/projects.

version.description: Spec rubric version this hub grades against.

extensions.description: Extra axes or stricter thresholds, in plain words. Stage unlocks can't change.

probe_model.description: Model tier the hub's probes run on.

push.description: What this hub does when a project accepts push.

mirrors.description: Other hubs (OWNER/REPO) whose registries this hub reads, cited as the source.
